[Unit]
Description=Dell Git-backed fresh Penpot
Requires=docker.service
BindsTo=docker.service srv-penpot.mount
After=network-online.target docker.service srv-penpot.mount
RequiresMountsFor=/srv/penpot
PartOf=docker.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
Environment=DELL_MOUNT_GATED=1
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/dell/penpot/application/fresh-target.py start
ExecStop=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/dell/penpot/application/fresh-target.py stop
TimeoutStartSec=300
TimeoutStopSec=180
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
